description: This file defines the setup wizard configuration for integrating Mattermost into a larger application, including status, intro notes, environment variable shortcuts, credentials, and input prompts.

methods.name: resolveConfigured
methods.description: Determines if the Mattermost setup is configured based on account secrets and configuration.

methods.name: shouldShow
methods.description: Decides whether to display the intro note based on configuration status.

methods.name: isAvailable
methods.description: Checks if environment variable shortcut options are available for Mattermost setup.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies configuration patches to set up environment variables for Mattermost.

methods.name: inspect
methods.description: Inspects current credentials to determine if the account is configured and has values.

methods.name: shouldPrompt
methods.description: Determines if the user should be prompted for the Mattermost base URL.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the provided Mattermost base URL.

methods.name: normalizeValue
methods.description: Normalizes the input value for the Mattermost base URL.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables the Mattermost channel in the configuration.
